label: rem:maximal-ideal-defect-remark
title: The unit coordinate as the antipode fixed point
html: The point z = 1 of the maximal ideal at the unit coordinate is the fixed point of the antipode S, marking the unique location where the Hopf and Frobenius structures interact maximally. The local ring A_{\mathfrak{m}_1} captures the algebraic behavior near this singularity.
